source_title: Patrick Stewart’s Final Film Role Will Be in ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ - People.com
source_excerpt:
Stewart’s rep announced his death at age 86 on Oct. 29, two months before the release of his final movie, ‘Avengers: Doomsday’
Sir Patrick Stewart ’s final film role following his death will be in Avengers: Doomsday .
A rep for the actor announced in a statement on Oct. 29 that the legendary X-Men and Star Trek actor had died at 86 years old following a diagnosis of Alzheimer’s and Lewy body dementia.
Stewart’s death comes two months before the release of the Marvel movie, which introduces the X-Men into the Marvel Cinematic Universe for the first time in a major way. Avengers: Doomsday premieres in theaters on Dec. 18.
The actor was first confirmed to be reprising his beloved role as Charles Xavier/Professor X, the leader of mutants, alongside Ian McKellen as Erik Lehnsherr/Magneto in March 2025.
Globe Photos/ZUMA Press Wire/Shutterstock
Stewart originated the character in 2000’s X-Men and went on to play the professor in three more sequels, as well as in cameos in three other movies, most recently in 2022’s Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness .
Though Stewart did not comment on the casting announcement at the time, the Star Trek alum appeared in the first Avengers: Doomsday trailer featuring the X-Men in January. In the snippet, Professor X reunites with Magneto over a chess game as Magneto says in a voiceover, “Death comes for us all. That’s all I know for sure.”
Three months before his death, Stewart spoke with TV Insider in what is now his final interview. He discussed his upcoming role in Doomsday , saying he had no intention of retiring from acting.
“As any actor my age will tell you, there are fewer and fewer available roles as we get older,” he said. “I can’t imagine ever officially ‘retiring.’ I’ll always and forever be an actor.”
Following the news of his death, Marvel Studios shared a tribute to the actor on X , writing that “all of us” are “deeply saddened” by Stewart’s death.
“Sir Patrick brought Professor Charles Xavier to life with extraordinary grace, intelligence, and humanity, defining the character for generations of fans, from ‘X-Men’ to ‘Logan’ to ‘Avengers: Doomsday,’ ” the studio wrote. “He was a singular talent, a generous collaborator, and a true gentleman. Our hearts go out to his wife Sunny, his children, his friends, and the countless fans around the world whose lives he touched with his art.”
Joining Stewart and McKellen in Doomsday are their fellow X-Men costars, including James Marsden , Alan Cumming , Rebecca Romijn and Kelsey Grammer .
